1. Extract current bill data: total due ($158.17), days in period (31), energy used (843 kWh), and line items (customer charge, energy charge, riders/adjustments).  
2. Extract last month’s data: total due ($150.18), days (31), and energy used (820 kWh).  
3. Compute the net dollar change: current total minus last month’s total.  
4. Decompose the change: set days_usd based on any day-count difference; derive price_usd from rate changes and usage_usd from kWh changes; set weather_usd to $0 because no weather data is provided.  
5. Audit for billing errors: verify meter-read subtraction equals billed kWh and that line items sum to the total; record any discrepancy as billing_error_usd.  
6. Return a JSON object with price_usd, days_usd, weather_usd, usage_usd, billing_error_suspected, and billing_error_usd.
